changes.title: Playtest rules
items: Babies join when their area gets a soundsystem; they cannot be invited with letters or conversation.
Wild pursuers follow you across area borders on foot. Take off to end an ordinary chase; hunters stop when you fly outside their area.
Only legends whose quests you completed dance at the final party. The others sleep in their circles.
Friendly legends defend you first, engage nearby enemies, then walk along the ley line towards its growing tip.
On each animal's island, its friendly legend now guards your home area instead of carrying the treehouse.
Legends can dream of a kind anywhere on the map, with no distance cap.
Rhino and unicorn legends now make long charges; ordinary rhinos and unicorns keep their attacks.
Legends now crouch before long charges and stretch into their run.

changes.title: Creature size range
items: Small animals are easier to see, babies and youngsters are more distinct, and the largest adults have more room to grow. Legends are larger than their own adults without towering so far above them.

changes.title: Stiltwalkers potion
items: Stiltwalkers replaces Tall Tales: familiar animal bodies ride high on long legs that taper to tiny feet.
